reason: Schema and engine-command rules for cornerstone-platform surfaced in the CP-8 design review (three fresh reviewers found blockers each time a new table, grant or command was drafted without these). Future migration or CLI designs need them up front, and the timetable fortnight rule was relayed by Nimish.

Merge database-access-rules into engine-schema-change as an access-rules subsection: both are Postgres work in this repo, and the schema skill is already the broader umbrella. Widen its trigger to cover grants, row-level security and access-rule proofs.
Retitle the umbrella to its real class (Postgres schema and access) now that it absorbs the access-rules skill.

Absorb database-access-rules as a labeled subsection. Its rules are kept; the one conflict with the grants bullet is resolved: default privileges grant app_web select on new tables, but the restricted role's access test still fails for an unclassified table, so each new table must be classified when added.
The session index truncates descriptions at 60 characters; the widened trigger from the earlier patch would be cut mid-clause. Shorten it to fit the budget while keeping the access-rule trigger.
